message.content: As your physician, I must address your concerns carefully. Your symptoms could stem from muscular tension or strain, perhaps due to poor posture or stress-induced clenching. Alternatively, you might be experiencing mild inflammation from acid reflux, where stomach acid irritates the throat without causing typical respiratory signs. Another possibility is a localized allergic reaction or minor skin irritation that hasn't manifested visibly yet. I recommend monitoring your symptoms closely. If pain persists or worsens, we should explore further diagnostic options to pinpoint the exact cause accurately.
